title: Quaint Romantic Korean Fish Kalguksu
description: A traditional Korean noodle soup dish featuring a delicate fish broth, chewy kalguksu noodles, and fresh mitsuba, all combining to create a romantic and comforting meal. This pescatarian-friendly dish is perfect for a cozy evening in.
instructions: Bring the fish broth to a boil in a large pot, then reduce the heat to a simmer.
Add the kalguksu noodles to the pot and cook for 5 minutes, or until they are slightly undercooked.
While the noodles are cooking, heat the sesame oil in a pan over medium heat and add the minced garlic, cooking for 1 minute.
Add the katsuramuki-cut daikon to the pan and cook for 2 minutes, or until it is slightly tender.
Add the chopped mitsuba to the pan and cook for 1 minute, or until it is wilted.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and stir to combine with the daikon and mitsuba mixture.
Add the fish cake to the pan and cook for 1 minute, or until it is heated through.
Season the dish with soy sauce to taste.
Serve the kalguksu hot, garnished with chopped green onions and a sprinkle of sesame oil.
